basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Seattle who recently discovered the world of anime. I enjoy exploring fantasy worlds and connecting with other fans online. My interests include anime, gaming, and music (I play the guitar in my free time). I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours during the evenings after classes. I'm pursuing a degree in Graphic Design and hope to work in the entertainment industry someday.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing interest in anime, which started about a year ago. I mostly learn about different series through online discussions, streaming platforms, and by following anime news sites. My knowledge is still expanding, but I'm eager to learn more. Additionally, my studies in Graphic Design have given me a keen eye for animation and visual storytelling.
